title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Dispersion — 2022
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: What is meant by dispersion of light? Why does white light disperse into seven colours when passed through a glass prism?
questions.solution:
**Dispersion:** The splitting of a beam of white light into its constituent seven colours (VIBGYOR) when it passes through a dispersive medium is called dispersion.

**Reason:** The refractive index $\mu$ of the glass is **different for different colours**, and since $\mu$ depends on the wavelength (or frequency) of light, violet light (shortest wavelength) is deviated most and red light (longest wavelength) is deviated least.
$$\mu_v > \mu_r$$
Therefore the band of colours fans out and they appear separately on the screen.
questions.knowledgeNote: Dispersion happens because refractive index of the medium varies with the wavelength of light.
